hints.title: Bitmask for Matched Elements
hints.text: Use a bitmask of length n where the j-th bit indicates whether nums2[j] has been chosen.

hints.title: Current Index from Popcount
hints.text: The number of set bits in mask determines which index i in nums1 is currently being matched.

hints.title: State Transition
hints.text: Transition from mask to mask | (1 << j) by adding (nums1[i] ^ nums2[j]) for every unset bit j.

hints.title: Full Implementation

complexity.whyNaiveFails: Testing all n! permutations is 14! ~ 8.7 * 10^10 which times out.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: Bitmask dynamic programming evaluates all 2^14 states in O(14 * 2^14) ~ 2.3 * 10^5 operations.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Candidate realizes set bit count in mask matches index in nums1.
